انتخبتا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَخَبَتَا (intaḵabatā) /in.ta.xa.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
# اُنْتُخِبَتَا (untuḵibatā) /un.tu.xi.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
